sources.title: Mirai president describes current Ogaki data-center operations
sources.publisher: Impress / Cloud Watch; firsthand interview with Mirai Communication Network
sources.attribution: Impress / Cloud Watch; firsthand interview with Mirai Communication Network
sources.summary: President Yoshihito Ito describes current colocation, hosting and network services in Ogaki. Hosting is the main growth business; customers include government bodies, universities and private companies. He reports groundwater-assisted cooling efficiency work and says the facilities are not designed for high-density GPU workloads. September 29 is the interview publication date; the interview day is undisclosed. The testimony concerns existing Ogaki operations and does not establish a new opening or individual-building utilization.

firsthand_status_statement.statement: The president describes current hosting, colocation and network operations and states that Mirai publicly discloses its data-center location.

sources.title: MiraiDC facilities index identifies the two Ogaki data centers
sources.summary: The operator presents MiraiDC / Mirai Data Center Park as its Ogaki facility and links separate specifications for Mirai Ogaki No.1 and No.2. The two buildings have different power, cooling and security specifications. This page provides the named campus and building identities; it is undated and does not establish a new operating-observation day.

sources.title: Mirai Ogaki No.1 and No.2 data-center specifications, version 3.1
sources.summary: The specification is explicitly current as of May 30, 2024. No.1 is at Kagano 4-1-12, with up to 200 racks and a June 2003 service start; its third floor is offices. No.2 lists up to 300 racks, an August 2015 service start, seismic isolation for the server building, redundant UPS and generators with 48 hours of fuel. The rack figures are maximum accommodation, not occupied racks or IT load. No.1 is leased from Mirai Industry; No.2 is owned by the operator. These are historical specifications, not measurements refreshed in 2026.

sources.title: Operator identifies adjacent Ogaki No.1 and No.2 properties
sources.summary: The operator directs No.2 data-center visitors to No.1 parking directly across the road and explicitly gives No.1’s address as Kagano 4-1-12, Ogaki. This resolves the relationship between the adjacent properties. The November 2023 parking notice is address and campus-layout evidence, not a current status observation.

sources.title: Operator access page selects the Kagano 4-1-12 property map
sources.summary: Mirai’s access page gives Kagano 4-1-12, Ogaki and embeds a named Google place for Mirai Communication Network at that address. The separate data-center specification and parking notice explicitly locate No.1 in this building; its identity is not inferred from the headquarters address alone.
